load_nllb_tokenizer: load an NLLB tokenizer from a SentencePiece model path with language config
create_encoder_source: create a source token encoder with language prefix tokens for NLLB translation
create_encoder_target: create a target token encoder with EOS prefix for NLLB translation output
create_decoder: create a token decoder to decode NLLB SentencePiece tokens back to text
create_raw_encoder: create a raw SentencePiece encoder without language prefix tokens for NLLB
